about_the_game:
Life Souls is a co-op action roguelike RPG where every fight is a challenge and every victory makes you stronger. Face intense arena battles, unpredictable events, and epic bosses that will push your skills to the limit.

What’s inside:

  • Co-op for up to 6 players. Team up with friends or take the risk solo.

  • Unique builds. Mix skills and artifacts to create devastating combos.

  • Class system. Experiment with abilities and find the playstyle that fits you best.

  • Artifacts. Earn gold in battle and gear up during each run.

  • Epic bosses. After waves of enemies, prepare for massive showdowns.

  • Arena events. Random twists can throw battles into chaos or give you the upper hand.

  • Pets. Loyal companions that gather resources for you.

  • Permanent progression. Unlock new abilities and upgrade your soul to make every run feel fresh.

Do you have what it takes to survive every trial and face the final boss?

content_descriptors.notes: Life Souls contains intense violence, blood and gore.
